system.flavor:
Glide across a chasm from the high side, drop from a tower window and land unhurt, skim over a bog or a burning floor, or cut a rope as you pass it.

Not enough to fly, gain height, or carry anyone with you.

body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two enemies adjacent to spaces along a 3-unit clear path.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move along the path, briefly gliding over ground hazards. On success, deal 1 Slashing Damage to each selected target. End supported.

surges.html: One hit target is pushed 1 unit away from the path.

rider.title: Adaptation - Strider
rider.html: Assume Razorwings (upkeep 1): once on your turn, glide up to 2 units as part of normal Movement, ignoring ground terrain. You cannot hover or gain height.
